entities.summary: Alimihan Seyiti was a Chinese supercentenarian, who was claimed to be one of the last survivors of the 19th century. She claimed to have been born in 19th century but due to a lack of a reliable birth registration system, her exact age could not be internationally verified by Guinness World Records.
